meta.title: Trace Lab
meta.description: Reads the current session's trace log as a product view instead of raw JSON. Open the Trace Lab tab in the conversation view ring, next to Trajectory. The top card is a heat matrix with one column per run — three metric rows (time, tokens, steps, shaded by rank inside the session) plus a marker lane for errors and slow operations. Point at a column to read that run and highlight its row; click to park it at the top of the list and expand it. Below, every run row carries its own time and token bars and a tag telling you what the step did; expand a step to see the model reply, each tool's arguments and result, the injected context, and a collapsed RAW view of the original events. Timing is the official one: step time is model plus tools, waiting for you is listed separately and never counted. The panel is read-only — it adds no model requests, reads the session log locally, and polls the log offset every 2 seconds while visible so a live session keeps updating. It covers the current session only: there is no cross-session comparison, lineage view, search or export.
